clips.send: Watch out: negative6 has the larger absolute value, because it is farther from 0. But it is the smaller number. Being farther left always means smaller, no matter how far from zero.
clips.text: Watch out: -6 has the larger absolute value, because it is farther from 0. But it is the smaller number. Being farther left always means smaller, no matter how far from zero.

clips.send: 3 and negative3 are the same distance from 0, on opposite sides. They are opposites: fold the line at 0 and one lands on the other. The opposite of negative3 is negative(negative3) equals 3 .
clips.text: 3 and -3 are the same distance from 0, on opposite sides. They are opposites: fold the line at 0 and one lands on the other. The opposite of -3 is -(-3) = 3.

clips.send: At 3 pm it is 6 degrees C. Overnight the air cools to 0 degrees C, and keeps falling. By dawn it is 4 degrees below zero. We write that as negative4 degrees C: a negative number.
clips.text: At 3 pm it is 6 circC. Overnight the air cools to 0 circC, and keeps falling. By dawn it is 4 degrees below zero. We write that as -4 circC: a negative number.

clips.send: The absolute value |a| is a number’s distance from 0. negative5 is 5 steps from zero, so |negative5| equals 5 ; and |5| equals 5 too. A distance is never negative.
clips.text: The absolute value |a| is a number’s distance from 0. -5 is 5 steps from zero, so |-5| = 5; and |5| = 5 too. A distance is never negative.

clips.send: On a number line, numbers get greater as you move right. negative2 is to the right of negative6 , so negative2 is greater than negative6 . Think temperature: negative2 degrees C is warmer than negative6 degrees C.
clips.text: On a number line, numbers get greater as you move right. -2 is to the right of -6, so -2 > -6. Think temperature: -2 circC is warmer than -6 circC.

clips.send: Worked example: order negative5, 3, negative1, 0, negative7, 6 from least to greatest. Drop each number onto the line, then read from left to right: negative7 is less than negative5 is less than negative1 is less than 0 is less than 3 is less than 6 .
clips.text: Worked example: order -5, 3, -1, 0, -7, 6 from least to greatest. Drop each number onto the line, then read from left to right: -7 < -5 < -1 < 0 < 3 < 6.

clips.send: The three rules in one place. Opposites: a and negativea are the same distance from 0. Absolute value: |a| is that distance, so |a| equals |negativea| . Order: a is less than b exactly when a is to the left of b .
clips.text: The three rules in one place. Opposites: a and -a are the same distance from 0. Absolute value: |a| is that distance, so |a| = |-a|. Order: a < b exactly when a is to the left of b.

clips.send: Turn the vertical scale on its side and you get a number line that keeps going left of zero. Positive numbers are to the right of 0, negative numbers to the left, and 0 itself is neither.
clips.text: Turn the vertical scale on its side and you get a number line that keeps going left of zero. Positive numbers are to the right of 0, negative numbers to the left, and 0 itself is neither.

clips.send: Negative numbers describe the opposite direction from a zero point. Sea level is 0: a bird 3 m above it is at plus 3 , a fish 4 m below it is at negative4 . (Money works the same way: owing 5 dollars is negative5 .)
clips.text: Negative numbers describe the opposite direction from a zero point. Sea level is 0: a bird 3 m above it is at +3, a fish 4 m below it is at -4. (Money works the same way: owing 5 dollars is -5.)

clips.send: 例题：把 负5, 3, 负1, 0, 负7, 6 从小到大排列。把每个数放到数轴上，再从左往右读： 负7 小于 负5 小于 负1 小于 0 小于 3 小于 6 。
clips.text: 例题：把 -5, 3, -1, 0, -7, 6 从小到大排列。把每个数放到数轴上，再从左往右读：-7 < -5 < -1 < 0 < 3 < 6。

clips.send: 把竖直的刻度横过来，就得到一条向 0 的左边继续延伸的数轴。正数在 0 的右边，负数在 0 的左边，0 既不是正数也不是负数。
clips.text: 把竖直的刻度横过来，就得到一条向 0 的左边继续延伸的数轴。正数在 0 的右边，负数在 0 的左边，0 既不是正数也不是负数。

clips.send: 在数轴上，越往右数越大。 负2 在 负6 的右边，所以 负2 大于 负6 。想想气温： 负2 度 C 比 负6 度 C 暖和。
clips.text: 在数轴上，越往右数越大。-2 在 -6 的右边，所以 -2 > -6。想想气温：-2 circC 比 -6 circC 暖和。

clips.send: 注意： 负6 的绝对值更大，因为它离 0 更远。但它却是更小的数。在数轴上越靠左越小，和离 0 有多远无关。
clips.text: 注意：-6 的绝对值更大，因为它离 0 更远。但它却是更小的数。在数轴上越靠左越小，和离 0 有多远无关。

clips.send: 把三条规律放在一起。相反数： a 与 负a 到 0 的距离相同。绝对值： |a| 就是这个距离，所以 |a| 等于 |负a| 。大小： a 在 b 的左边，就有 a 小于 b 。
clips.text: 把三条规律放在一起。相反数：a 与 -a 到 0 的距离相同。绝对值：|a| 就是这个距离，所以 |a| = |-a|。大小：a 在 b 的左边，就有 a < b。

clips.send: 下午 3 点气温是 6 度 C。夜里降到 0 度 C，而且还在继续下降。到了清晨，已经是零下 4 度了。我们把它写成 负4 度 C：这是一个负数。
clips.text: 下午 3 点气温是 6 circC。夜里降到 0 circC，而且还在继续下降。到了清晨，已经是零下 4 度了。我们把它写成 -4 circC：这是一个负数。

clips.send: 3 和 负3 到 0 的距离相同，但在 0 的两侧。它们互为相反数：把数轴沿 0 对折，一个正好落在另一个上。 负3 的相反数是 负(负3) 等于 3 。
clips.text: 3 和 -3 到 0 的距离相同，但在 0 的两侧。它们互为相反数：把数轴沿 0 对折，一个正好落在另一个上。-3 的相反数是 -(-3) = 3。

clips.send: 负数表示与零点方向相反的量。把海平面记作 0：海面上方 3 米的鸟在 加 3 ，海面下方 4 米的鱼在 负4 。（钱也一样：欠 5 美元记作 负5 。）
clips.text: 负数表示与零点方向相反的量。把海平面记作 0：海面上方 3 米的鸟在 +3，海面下方 4 米的鱼在 -4。（钱也一样：欠 5 美元记作 -5。）

clips.send: 绝对值 |a| 表示一个数到 0 的距离。 负5 离 0 有 5 格，所以 |负5| 等于 5 ； |5| 也等于 5。距离永远不会是负数。
clips.text: 绝对值 |a| 表示一个数到 0 的距离。-5 离 0 有 5 格，所以 |-5| = 5；|5| 也等于 5。距离永远不会是负数。
